data.one_liner: An accessible, theme-aware Flutter calendar with lazy month and week paging.
data.what_it_does: Provides a calendar widget supporting both month and week views with lazy paging. It handles controlled date selection, custom event markers, day building, and localization.
use_when: You need a customizable month or week calendar view in your Flutter application.
You want to render application events or markers directly onto calendar dates.
avoid_when: You require a complex date-range picker rather than a calendar display widget.
strengths: Lazy month and week paging for performance.
Theme-aware with robust layout and header configurations.
Accessible structure with localized date semantics.
weaknesses: Requires manual parent layout constraints (like a SizedBox) for sizing.

alternatives.name: table_calendar
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another popular, highly customizable calendar widget option for Flutter.
